subject: prd/local-git-codehost
statement: When an empty local origin receives its first configured-mainline push, Pyxis shall support a base-free proof; until that push completes, local draft open and preparation shall refuse with a first-push remedy; later pushes shall require normal history gates.
fit_criterion: First-push fixture succeeds, pre-push draft open/prepare name the remedy, initialized-origin draft proceeds, and subsequent violating push refuses
